description: The boxes a camera fit over several tracks frames (docs/SPEC.md FR-5.8): a Trip's first fit, the Dates flight, the opening view and the list flight. A Pending track is left out, and so is a Private one, whose bbox is its location's circle: only focusing that one row flies there. A track with no bbox has nothing to frame. Boxes keep the tracks' order.
